result.instructions: Tools for Sender.net, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many subscribers are in our 'Newsletter' group, and how many joined this month?"; "Show the open and click counts for our last sent campaign."; "Create a draft campaign with the subject 'Our year-end offer' for the VIP group, so I can review it in Sender.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sender.net data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sendernet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sendernet_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sendernet_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sendernet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sendernet_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: List subscribers in the account, one page at a time. Sender API: GET /v2/subscribers.

tools.name: sendernet_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get a subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber by email address, phone number or subscriber id, with status and group data. Sender API: GET /v2/subscribers/{id}.

subscriber.description: Subscriber email, phone number or id (from a list tool).

tools.name: sendernet_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List subscriber groups with their ids and subscriber counts. Sender API: GET /v2/groups.

tools.name: sendernet_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: Get one subscriber group by id. Sender API: GET /v2/groups/{id}.

tools.name: sendernet_list_group_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers in a group
tools.description: List the subscribers of one group. Sender API: GET /v2/groups/{id}/subscribers.

tools.name: sendernet_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List saved subscriber segments (rule-based audiences). Sender API: GET /v2/segments/.

tools.name: sendernet_get_segment
tools.title: Get a segment
tools.description: Get one segment by id. Sender API: GET /v2/segments/{id}.

tools.name: sendernet_list_segment_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers in a segment
tools.description: List the subscribers that match one segment. Sender API: GET /v2/segments/{id}/subscribers.

tools.name: sendernet_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns, optionally filtered by one status (DRAFT, SCHEDULED, SENDING or SENT). Sender API: GET /v2/campaigns.

tools.name: sendernet_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign by id, with its subject, sender and status. Sender API: GET /v2/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: sendernet_get_campaign_stats
tools.title: Get campaign statistics
tools.description: Get one campaign's sent emails, opens, clicks or unsubscribes. Sender API: GET /v2/campaigns/{id}/emails-sent, /opens, /clicks, /unsubscribes.

tools.name: sendernet_list_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the custom subscriber fields of the account, with their names. Sender API: GET /v2/fields.

tools.name: sendernet_add_subscriber
tools.title: Add a subscriber
tools.description: Create a subscriber with an email, optional names, groups, custom fields and phone. Does not send email unless trigger_automation is true. Sender API: POST /v2/subscribers.

fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field name, e.g. {"{$company}": "Acme"}.

trigger_automation.description: Start automations for this change. Default false: no automation (and no email) runs unless true.

tools.name: sendernet_update_subscriber
tools.title: Update a subscriber
tools.description: Change a subscriber's names, groups, custom fields, phone or status (ACTIVE, UNSUBSCRIBED, BOUNCED, SPAM_REPORTED). Overwrites the fields you pass. Sender API: PATCH /v2/subscribers/{id}.

subscriber.description: Subscriber email, phone number or id (from a list tool).

fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field name, e.g. {"{$company}": "Acme"}.

trigger_automation.description: Start automations for this change. Default false: no automation (and no email) runs unless true.

tools.name: sendernet_add_subscribers_to_group
tools.title: Add subscribers to a group
tools.description: Add existing subscribers, by email address, to one group. Does not send email unless trigger_automation is true. Sender API: POST /v2/subscribers/groups/{groupId}.

trigger_automation.description: Start automations for this change. Default false: no automation (and no email) runs unless true.

tools.name: sendernet_remove_subscribers_from_group
tools.title: Remove subscribers from a group
tools.description: Remove subscribers, by email address, from one group. The subscribers stay in the account. Sender API: DELETE /v2/subscribers/groups/{groupId}.

subscribers.description: Email addresses to remove from the group.

trigger_automation.description: Start automations for this change. Default false: no automation (and no email) runs unless true.

tools.name: sendernet_create_group
tools.title: Create a group
tools.description: Create an empty subscriber group with a name. Sender API: POST /v2/groups.

tools.name: sendernet_rename_group
tools.title: Rename a group
tools.description: Change the name of one group. Sender API: PATCH /v2/groups/{id}.

tools.name: sendernet_create_campaign
tools.title: Create a draft campaign
tools.description: Create a DRAFT email campaign with a subject, sender name, reply-to address, HTML or text content and target groups. It is not sent: a person must send it in Sender. Sender API: POST /v2/campaigns.

reply_to.description: Reply-to email; its domain must be verified in Sender.

content.description: Campaign body in the chosen format.

groups.description: Group ids that will receive the campaign once sent.

prompts.name: check_the_results_of_a_sent_campaign
prompts.title: Check the results of a sent campaign
prompts.description: List the campaigns, then read one campaign with its subject and status. Get its sent, open, click and unsubscribe counts.

prompts.name: look_up_one_subscriber

prompts.description: Get a subscriber by email address to read the status and group data. List the custom fields to see their names.

prompts.description: Add a new subscriber, or add existing subscribers to a group. No email is sent unless automation is turned on.

prompts.title: Prepare a draft campaign for review
prompts.description: List the groups to find the target audience, then create a draft campaign. A person sends it in Sender.
